install_extension_from_github: install an hf CLI extension from a public GitHub repository in OWNER/hf-name format
execute_installed_extension: execute an installed hf CLI extension by name with optional arguments passed after --
list_installed_extensions: list all installed hf CLI extensions with their source, type, and installation date
search_available_extensions: search GitHub for extensions tagged with the hf-extension topic sorted by stars
remove_installed_extension: remove an installed hf CLI extension by name with or without hf- prefix
